name: ReD_Bench
description:
TL;DR
	

This repo provides usage guidance and all data samples for our proposed dataset, ReD Bench, a new image drag-editing dataset supporting both region-based and point-based operations.
  
  
  

	
		
	
	
		Introduction
	

Regional-based Dragging (ReD) Bench, consisting of 120 sample images annotated with precise drag instructions at both point and region levels. Each manipulation in the dataset is associated with an intention label, selected from relocation, deformation, or… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Edennnnn/ReD_Bench.
reputation: Small, specialized dataset for research in interactive drag-based image editing with limited adoption.
